title: Fresh-clone test run: declare missing test dependencies, run tests/ in CI, fix the replay test mismatches
description: On a fresh clone make test cannot pass: five tests import spacy (only in the build extras), three import tokenizers (not declared anywhere), and 21 assertions in tests/veteran_sexuality_replay_test.py fail, which looks like drift between the committed studies and what replay produces. CI runs pytest on biased_decisions and scripts only, never on tests/. Declare the dependencies or skip cleanly when absent, add tests/ to the replay workflow, and resolve the 21 mismatches by regenerating the studies or fixing the scorer, whichever the record supports.
